name: Knott's Berry Market (California Marketplace) Take-Home Jar of Strained Seedless Boysenberry Jelly (Skip Preserves!)
brandOrRestaurant: Knott's Berry Market (California Marketplace · Knott's Berry Farm)
whyItWorks: At the Knott's Berry Market gift shop, you can buy jars of **Knott's Seedless Boysenberry Jelly** (or Boysenberry Syrup)—which is 100% strained of all berry seeds so you can enjoy authentic boysenberry on sourdough toast and buttermilk biscuits at home with 0g fiber!
prepOrOrderInstructions: Look closely at the jar label in Berry Market: buy **"Seedless Boysenberry Jelly"** or **"Boysenberry Syrup"**—do NOT buy regular "Boysenberry Preserves" (which is full of whole seeds).
watchOuts: Always check that the label says "Jelly" or "Seedless"—never "Preserves" with seeds
